messages:
Maya Patel: quick sync — we need to land a proposal for long-term routing + multi-region isolation that unblocks Q3 roadmap. customer asks piling up; want consensus on launch criteria and what we defer.
Ajay Singh: +1. main tradeoff is strict tenant isolation vs cost/efficiency. customers want guarantees for PII workloads.
Nora Chen: can we define 2 launch tiers? T1 = regional isolation (soft guarantees, telemetry + SLA), T2 = full tenant fencing (hard guarantees, dedicated pools).
Maya Patel: I like tiers. propose launch criteria for T1: documented failure modes, canary for 10% traffic, SLOs + per-tenant latency baseline, migration playbook.
Samir Rao: infra question — do we require separate routing fabric for T1 or an isolation flag on existing fabric? the latter cheaper but riskier.
Ajay Singh: flag on existing fabric w/ guardrails might be OK for T1 if we can auto-evacuate noisy tenants. need eviction policy + capacity gating.
Nora Chen: customer-driven asks: 1) per-tenant bandwidth limits, 2) geo-locking of data, 3) audit logs. Those map to routing + infra + compliance.
Maya Patel: agree. add telemetry requirements: token-level latency breakdown, per-route error budgeting, and a health endpoint we can use for canary gating.
Samir Rao: technical note — we'll need KV cache scoping. current shared KV cache leaks performance across tenants if one tenant uses very long contexts. plan: per-tenant cache quota for T1.
Ajay Singh: ops: rollout plan sketch — dev sandbox ➜ internal beta (select customers) ➜ gradual canary at 1%, 5%, 10% ➜ broad. fallback policy: route to compatible model variant in other region if tenant fails gating.
Maya Patel: decision needed: do we require dedicated capacity for T1? my vote: no. allow shared dedicated pools but strictly enforced quotas + automatic failover. saves cost for customers.
Nora Chen: compliance team will push back on shared pools for certain regulated customers. let's make an explicit contract: "shared by default, dedicated on request + compliance review".
Samir Rao: sample routing config (proto) for gated rollout:
```
routing:
  policy: tenant_affinity
  isolation_tier: T1
  cache_quota: 256MB
  failover: regional_preference
  canary: true
```
Ajay Singh: sounds good. action items: Maya to draft launch criteria doc, Samir to size cache/quota experiments, Nora to collect customer priority list and compliance asks.
Maya Patel: timeline: draft by EOD Friday, internal beta by mid-July. can everyone ack and add blockers? :thumbsup:
Ajay Singh: ack.
Nora Chen: ack, will ping compliance this afternoon.
Samir Rao: ack — running capacity sims this week, will post logs to the thread.
infra-bot: deploy-bot posted: canary job started for "routing-v2-canary" at 1745552450.
Maya Patel: thanks — if any one-off customer constraints surface, flag them here. we'll use this thread for the spec iteration.
